items.title: File Adams County business personal property return
items.description: The Nebraska personal property return and schedule is due to the county assessor where the property sits on or before May 1; a separate return is needed in each county. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file the return; the personal property tax is billed on the assessed value at the local rate.

penalty.note: 10% of the tax on value added by June 30 and 25% on value added from July 1 (Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-1233.04).

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file the return; the personal property tax is billed on the assessed value at the local rate.

penalty.note: 10% of the tax on value added by June 30 and 25% on value added from July 1 (Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-1233.04).
